source_caption:
The original six Avengers will always have a special place in Marvel history.

Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye. Six completely different heroes who came together in The Avengers (2012) and changed superhero movies forever.

Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Scarlett Johansson, and Jeremy Renner gave us characters we followed for more than a decade. We watched them argue, fight alongside each other, become friends, and eventually turn into something closer to a family.

By the time Avengers: Endgame arrived in 2019, it wasn’t just about saving the universe anymore. It was about saying goodbye to characters we’d grown up with.

Marvel has introduced plenty of new heroes since then, but there’s something about seeing those original six standing together that still feels different.

An entire generation grew up with these characters, and no matter where the MCU goes next, this lineup will always be iconic.
